summary.text: Cinthia Moore is a Democratic Nevada Assembly member from District 11 who took office in November 2024 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
Ballotpedia lists her career experience as coordinating the Nevada Environmental Justice Coalition.

paragraphs.text: Moore was born in Jalisco, Mexico, according to Ballotpedia, and her career experience includes coordinating the Nevada Environmental Justice Coalition.
In a 2018 Ballotpedia survey, she listed improving career technical education, reducing domestic violence and economic development as her top priorities.
Moore assumed office on November 6, 2024, succeeding Beatrice Duran.
For 2025 and 2026 she was assigned to the Growth and Infrastructure, Judiciary, and Legislative Operations and Elections committees.
